title: Kooky Malty Indian Yogurt Lassi
description: A malty, flaky, hangover-cure Indian dish featuring creme fraiche, this lassi is an ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly drink, served in a stone bowl dolsot. It is a refreshing and rejuvenating beverage.
instructions: In a blender, combine creme fraiche, yogurt, malt powder, honey, cardamom powder, and salt.
Blend the mixture on high speed until smooth and creamy.
Add ice cubes to the blender and blend until the ice is crushed and the mixture is thick and frosty.
Add water to the blender and blend until well combined.
Taste the lassi and adjust the sweetness or consistency as needed.
Pour the lassi into stone bowl dolsots or glasses.
Serve the lassi immediately, garnished with a sprinkle of cardamom powder if desired.
